name: ai-agent-simulator
description: An interactive, educational visualizer that X-rays a real agentic AI request lifecycle: you type a message, a real LangGraph agent (RAG -> MCP tools -> LLM) runs and emits every stage as a stream of trace events, and the frontend animates those events across a graph of "stations" you can click to inspect the real data. Nothing is mocked and it runs only against OpenAI; bilingual en/pt, built spec-first and test-first. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
